== Notes ==
* Each of the four stones take turns in lighting up, going clockwise, every few seconds.
* After being destroyed or used in a recipe, [[Standing Stones Timepiece Remnant]] with the same Mystic Forge functionality can be bought from renown heart vendors in [[Lowland Shore]].
* This back item can be [[dye]]d. It has 4 dye channels.
* This item's description was updated from "This back item is used for crafting Janthir Wilds legendaries. Further copies can be purchased in the near future." with the [[Game updates/2025-06-24|June 24, 2025 game update]].
